description: Hypha turns your organization's documents into structured, searchable data. Connect it to ask questions across everything you've uploaded — contracts, financials, reports — and get precise answers grounded in the actual facts pulled from those documents, with every answer traceable back to its source. Explore what Hypha has organized for your organization and pull exactly the details you need, from high-level summaries down to specific figures.
